spec2def(xmllite.dll xmllite.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# xmllite.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xmllite-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(xmllite_shims OBJECT reader.c writer.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(xmllite_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(xmllite_shims)
add_cargo_module(xmllite xmllite-cargo xmllite.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xmllite_shims psdk uuid_sources)
